hooks.prompt: Check if any source code files (Python, JavaScript, XML) in this repository were modified in this session by running: git diff HEAD --name-only. If code files were changed AND README.md exists at the repo root, update README.md so it accurately reflects the current state of the code. Things to keep in sync: module name, version, features list, configuration fields and their names, API endpoints, setup steps, file structure diagram, and changelog. If no code files changed, do nothing.
